predecessors.name: Palestinian National Authority
predecessors.text: the Gaza Strip, which after Israel's withdrawal of 2005 'was left under the control of the Palestinian Authority'

ledger.x: 2023: Israel's ground invasion of the Gaza Strip begins.

wars.name: Battle of Gaza (2007)
wars.outcome: Hamas took full control of the Gaza Strip between 11 and 15 June 2007; Abbas dismissed the Haniyeh government on 14 June and appointed Salam Fayyad; the Palestinian Authority was left with the West Bank.

wars.name: Gaza War (2008-2009)
wars.outcome: The Gaza Strip page gives only the Israeli ground invasion of 3 January 2009; it states no result and no territorial change.

wars.name: 2014 Gaza War
wars.outcome: Israel launched Operation Protective Edge on 8 July 2014, a seven-week conflict; the page gives no end date, no ground held and no territorial change.

wars.name: Gaza war (2023-present)
wars.outcome: Ongoing at 2024: Israel's ground invasion began in early November 2023; on 6 January 2024 the Israeli government said Hamas rule in northern Gaza had been eliminated; Hamas began reviving some governing functions in parts of Gaza City from late January 2024.

certainty.note: The Strip is a fixed enclave (about 51 km of border with Israel, 11 km with Egypt along the Philadelphi corridor) but the pages name no treaty or survey line, so this is the outline, not a dated record.
